context.title: View toggle
context.description: Switch between Form view and Table view for the resource bundle editor.

context.title: Key tree
context.description: The key tree displays all keys in the resource bundle. Keys can be shown flat or hierarchically and filtered to show only incomplete translations.

context.title: Value editor
context.description: Edit the translation value for the selected key in a specific locale. Use the Comment checkbox to comment out the entry. Duplicate and similar value indicators are shown when detected.

context.title: Table view
context.description: Shows all keys and locales in a spreadsheet-style table. Click a cell or press F2 to edit. Changes are saved together with all other edits.

context.title: New locale
context.description: Add a new locale to the resource bundle. Enter the language, optional country and variant, then click Create.

context.title: General preferences
context.description: Configure general settings for the ResourceBundle Editor such as Unicode conversion, key tree defaults and locale filtering.

context.title: Formatting preferences
context.description: Configure how .properties files are formatted when saved, including equal-sign alignment, key grouping and line wrapping.

context.title: Performance preferences
context.description: Enable or disable potentially expensive reporting features such as missing-value detection and similar/duplicate-value detection.

context.title: New ResourceBundle wizard
context.description: Create a set of .properties files for a new resource bundle. Select a folder, enter a base name and add the desired locales.
